{
  "name": "colombian-claude",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Claude Code talks like a Colombian while it works: pick your accent, from rolo to costeño.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Lucas Leguizamo",
    "url": "https://github.com/LucasLeguizamo"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/LucasLeguizamo/colombian-claude",
  "repository": "https://github.com/LucasLeguizamo/colombian-claude",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "colombia",
    "spinner",
    "fun",
    "mod",
    "spanish"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "accent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Accent",
      "description": "Which Colombian accent the spinner speaks. 'mix' shuffles all of them.",
      "default": "rolo",
      "options": [
        "rolo",
        "paisa",
        "costeno",
        "caleno",
        "santandereano",
        "pastuso",
        "llanero",
        "boyacense",
        "mix"
      ]
    }
  }
}
